name: ddjp
description: Decentralized DJ Protocol — static client-side Matrix app. This manifest is BUILD/AUDIT ONLY: the app ships the vendored bundle in lib/ and needs no npm install to run. These devDependencies pin what the vendored SDK is built from, so Dependabot / npm audit can flag CVEs. eslint is pinned the same way: the LINT GUARD requires it (npm install), and a missing install FAILS the suite rather than skipping — see tests/check-lint.js.
